title.en: International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD)
title.hi: International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD)

definition.en: The IBRD is a global development cooperative owned by 189 member countries, functioning as the primary lending arm of the World Bank Group to promote sustainable development.
definition.hi: The IBRD is a global development cooperative owned by 189 member countries, functioning as the primary lending arm of the World Bank Group to promote sustainable development.

importanceInUpsc.en: Understanding the IBRD is essential for the UPSC GS-3 syllabus under the 'External Sector' and 'International Institutions' sections. It provides critical insights into how multilateral development banks influence India's infrastructure, poverty reduction, and economic reform agendas.
